pr_metadata.title: fix(obs): use a River raw string for the Alloy journal-drop regex
pr_metadata.summary: The #1029 journal-drop regex used an invalid double-quoted River escape (\.), so Alloy rejected its config and crash-looped fleet-wide — no logs to Loki or OpenSearch; switch to a backtick raw string and add a render guard that catches invalid River escapes at vrg-validate time.
pr_metadata.notes: Root cause of epic-198 #1022's empty OpenSearch. Live-validated: patching the running obs guest to the backtick form brought Alloy active and OpenSearch's today index went 0->1086 docs, queue-full settled to 0 (the #1029 drop rule breaks the amplification loop). Two non-blocking follow-up observations (logs still land): Data Prepper's ParseJsonProcessor errors on plain-text journal lines (noise), and transient restart backpressure. Cloud-safe (no workflow files). vrg-validate green. Full-fleet proof is the #1022 re-run after merge.
